test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Howard tried to speak but all that came out was an _______, squeaky gargle.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **'Inarticulate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is:** inarticulate**
 
• **"Inarticulate"** means unable to speak distinctly or express oneself clearly.
 
• **It fits the context** of the sentence as Howard is trying to speak but is unable to do so in a clear and understandable manner.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *Howard tried to speak but all that came out was an **inarticulate**, squeaky gargle. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are not appropriate:
 
 
• **"Implausible"** means not seeming reasonable or probable; failing to convince. It doesn't fit the context here because it doesn't describe the quality of speech or sound.
 
• **"Sincere"** refers to a person, feeling, or expression that is free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings. It doesn't describe the physical sound of someone's voice.
 
• **"Easy"** could refer to something requiring no great labor or effort, but it doesn't fit in this context because it doesn't describe a characteristic of someone's voice or speech.
